title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode3 Our Melody Goes Unheard

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, um...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys were really, really amazing! I was so moved by your music...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you for listening.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome!
Wait, no...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your performance was unbelievable and the songs you played really struck a chord with me... And, so, I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want you to teach me how to write songs like that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My band's also trying to go pro, so would it be possible for you to give us some advice regarding that...?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So you're also trying to debut with a big label...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, we are!
Which is why I want to learn how to write songs that move people's hearts like you, Saku!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm not sure I can teach songwriting very well.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: All I'm really doing is expressing how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Expressing how you feel...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But this show's also gonna be our chance to get more and more people to hear our music! It's gonna be a big step for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I should weave what I'm feeling right now into this song! I can spice up the chorus by...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I had the exact same idea.
But Saku's songs are way different...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Even though I went through the same process, my song didn't resonate with anyone in the crowd...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Is it because mine had a different theme? Saku's song felt pretty somber while mine was supposed to be bright and cheery...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Could that be why the crowd reacted so differently to our songs...? No, that doesn't seem like the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Is that all you'd like to ask me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
U-Um, just one more question...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you think of our songs, Saku...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I thought they were cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You did?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But they didn't really strike a chord with me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Member of anemone
rows.Line: S-Saku, wait...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Your second song was okay.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
However, your third one felt so empty.
It had a cute melody but that was it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, you don't have to be so...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Of course, every band has its own style and shouldn't be an issue as long as your bandmates are okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Besides, I'm sure there were people who enjoyed the music you played today.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: The kind of people who show up here probably won't find your style of music all that interesting.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So, if there's somewhere you already have a sort of home-field advantage, then you may want to just stick with that.

rows.Speaker: Member of anemone
rows.Line: You really need to stop!

rows.Speaker: Member of anemone
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Leo/need!
We'll be going now!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
See you later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They didn't feel anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That can't be true.
I really love your music, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Your songs always have this way of cheering me up...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also believe that your songs have been reaching people who we've been playing for at our usual live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Otherwise, I doubt that we'd have people calling themselves our fans.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This live house just might not be for us. At least, that's what I felt during our performance...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The atmosphere here and the audience were both very different.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Still, being told that no one would be interested in our music did sort of hit a nerve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I really don't think we need to play here if this place just doesn't suit our style.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Should we really be okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, I'm sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we do what you say and ignore what Saku said, I feel like we'd also be writing off how everyone else in the crowd felt.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna write a song that hits home with people at whatever live house we play...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Instead of running, we really should sit down and think about this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why didn't our music resonate with anybody here today...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're probably not in a state where we can come up with the right answer, so I'm gonna start thinking about this again after I get home...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna figure out how to write a song that gets these people's attention!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, we can also work on some other things.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
Our songs aren't the only thing that we learned that we need to work on today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: anemone's performance was so good too. I have to figure out a way to improve my drumming skills.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I want to get better too.
I want to sing better and put on better performances...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There's still plenty for us to work on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can do a debrief about all this another day. We can discuss what we can all do then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So for now, let's just make it our goal to put on a performance here next time that really reaches this crowd.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's do our best to make that happen!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They really didn't feel anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even though I wrote that song just for today's show and put a ton of thought into it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The crowds at the live houses we played at before all got into our music, so I was sure that my songs were reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But after hearing Saku sing...
I felt like there was no way the current me could write such a moving song.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, my songs don't really have the power to bring tears to anyone's eyes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But if I really work at it, can I do it?
Is it possible for me to write a song that really goes for your heart...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, beating myself up about this won't get me anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to regroup and think calmly about this. For the sake of Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on. Saku seemed to think our second song was sorta okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, right. We worked really hard on that one for Hanano and her brother...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, is that it...? Was it “okay” because we wrote it for somebody else...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, our new song wasn't really for anyone in particular. It was really just a song about how excited I was about this show...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which means... I have to think more about who's actually listening to us play, right...? Is that the answer...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For my next song, I'm gonna try focusing more on that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to think more about the people who I want to hear us play right now... I have to dig deep and think really hard!
